name: Rose Petals Herbal 100g Face Pack Helps to Removes dead cells, dirt and unclogs pores
original_description:
Herbals’ Rose Petal Powder with Multani is a perfect combination for anti-aging and rejuvenating the skin. This face pack deep cleans skin by removing dead cells, dirt, and opening up clogged pores and prevents premature lines.  Rose powder with multani is excellent for oily skin as it removes excess oil. Multani helps reduce redness, irritation and appearances caused by acne. The rose petals powder acts as a natural skin toner and adds extra-long lasting freshness, fragrance and glow to the skin.

Rose Petals, Natural Skin Toner

  1. Removes dead cells, dirt and unclogs pores
  2. Reduces redness, irritation and appearances caused by acne
  3. Natural skin toner, adds extra-long lasting freshness, fragrance and glow

Rose Petals Herbal Face Pack is NATURAL SKIN TONER

  • Removes dead cells, dirt and unclogs pores
  • Reduces redness, irritation & appearances caused by acne
  • Tones skin
  • Adds extra-long-lasting freshness, fragrance and glow to the skin
rewritten_description: Falcon Herbs' Rose Petals Herbal 100g Face Pack is a thoughtful blend of natural ingredients, including rose petals and multani. This face pack is designed to support skin wellness, promoting a balanced and refreshed complexion. The rose petals add a touch of gentle care, while the multani contributes to a soothing and calming experience. This face pack can be a wonderful addition to a daily skincare routine, helping to nourish and pamper the skin.
